item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Develop controlled history perturbations—removing recent repeated interactions, older isolated events, or sequence order—to test whether recommendations depend on evidence users consider relevant. Seek methods using only histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps, with abstention when evidence is insufficient.
